description: Certificate of Lawful Development (Proposed): Change of use from C3 (Dwelling houses) to C4 (HMO for up to 6 persons)
decision_conditions: The proposal, by reason of relying upon extensions that do not benefit from planning permission by virtue of the side to rear extensions not being built in accordance with planning permission granted under application reference PL/0386/25 would fall foul of Article 3(5)(a) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) which states that any development that falls within Schedule 2 of that Order does not apply in the case of permission granted in connection within an existing building, the building operations involved in the construction of that building are unlawful. Furthermore, the applicant has failed to provide accurate existing site plan, floor plans and elevations as the evidence noted by Officers on site show that the plot configuration has not been shown correctly on the submitted location/ block plan and it appears that there is an additional canopy structure attached to the side to rear extension which has not been shown on the existing plans. Therefore, notwithstanding the fact the proposal would rely on extensions that do not benefit from planning permission, the local planning authority cannot issue a lawful development certificate based on the inaccurate and conflicting&nbsp;information submitted by the applicant.&nbsp;
